com.altastata.filesystem.common

Class VersionAttributes

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.altastata.filesystem.common.VersionAttributes
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<VersionAttributes>

    public class VersionAttributes
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Comparable<VersionAttributes>, java.io.Serializable
    Holds cryptographic attributes, tags, and timestamps for a specific version of a CloudFile. Since AltaStata implements an append-only, version-controlled file system, each modification creates a new version tracked by an instance of this class. The version matches a unique creator tag (historically the creator's username) and creation time.
